final: WITH player_totals AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total FROM player_totals) SELECT SUM(pt.total), AVG(pt.total - o.average_total) FROM player_totals AS pt CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE pt.total > o.average_total
